USAGE:
    central-config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    central-config migrate --dry-run --diff
    central-config migrate -s MySolution.sln --transitive-pinning
    central-config migrate --merge --conflict-strategy Lowest
    central-config build --dry-run --diff
    central-config all --dry-run

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    migrate                Migrate the workspace to central package management  
    build                  Hoist shared MSBuild properties into                 
                           Directory.Build.props                                
    all                    Generate Directory.Build.props and                   
                           Directory.Packages.props together                    
    revert                 Undo central package management, inlining versions   
                           again                                                
    analyze                Score dependency health and report every problem     
                           found                                                
    update                 Update central versions, run the tests, roll back on 
                           failure                                              
    verify                 Migrate, then prove the resolved package graph did   
                           not change                                           
    tree                   Print the resolved dependency graph                  
    status                 One-shot dashboard of the workspace and what to do   
                           next                                                 
    doctor                 Diagnose the environment before anything else goes   
                           wrong                                                
    init                   Scaffold a .centralconfig.json                       
    explain                Explain an analysis rule, or list them all           
    bat
[truncated]
